title: ModelRouteRevision
description: An immutable, publishable revision of a model route (spec §27.6, E13 T8): the model id and the connection that redeems it. A draft never steers a run; publishing makes it the project's routed target. The routing fields are never rewritten — a revise INSERTs a new revision. A thin projection (e.g. a publish acknowledgement) may omit the fields it did not read back.

resolved_by_dispatch.description: Whether THIS is the revision a run resolves through — the highest-numbered PUBLISHED revision of the alias (ties broken by id, exactly as ResolveProjectModelRoute orders). It exists because publishing does not un-publish: `published` accumulates, so a route revised four times shows four published revisions, possibly naming different models, with nothing marking which one steers a run. Rendered on the LIST read, where the whole set is known; absent from a singular GET, which cannot see the siblings it would have to compare against. A route with no published revision marks none.

model.description: The model id placed on the provider wire.

thinking.description: Ask runs on this route to return the model's reasoning where a person can read it, journalled as model_step.thinking.v1. ABSENT means the provider is asked for nothing, which is NOT the same as the model not reasoning — an adaptive model reasons regardless and bills for it. It is pinned on the revision rather than set per request because whether the ask is even valid depends on the model this revision names: measured 2026-08-04, the request succeeds on claude-sonnet-5 and claude-opus-4-6 and returns 400 on the whole 4.5 generation.

published.description: Whether this revision is the project's routed target.
